note: Curated descriptive names for the decompiled flat DOS/4G image (stage 07). Addresses are image-relative (flat image imported at base 0). These are OUR analysis conclusions: each entry is added as its meaning is established from reading decompiled.c, and the docs/ notes carry the evidence. g_mode_flag gates init in main and toggles behavior across many subsystems; exact semantics TBD. The RNG names (rng_*) and asteroid-gen names (asteroid_*) are documented in docs/mechanics/rng.md and docs/mechanics/asteroid-creation.md. The game itself names these objects asteroids (the universe's colonizable worlds, each with its own surface); earlier drafts called them galaxies, which the game never does. asteroid_create makes a new asteroid node (rolls size class, surface width and seed); asteroid_place finds a free sector-grid slot and sets the node position; asteroid_gen_start_values rolls the 10 per-planet starting values into +0x6c; asteroid_setup_start_values copies them from a same-type asteroid, a static table, or an RNG perturbation; asteroid_rank_start_values scores the ten values against the per-slot divisor table and stores the best index at +0x53; obj_list_pop removes and returns the head node of an intrusive list. The locals section renames function-scoped register/stack names (iVar3, sVar1, in_EAX, ...); entries are added only where the meaning is confirmed by disassembly and documented in docs/.
